title: Spine patterns for modular 2D assembly
plainLanguage: Spine is useful here as an example of how 2D systems keep bones, artwork attachments, draw order, optional item-specific controls, and perspective-like deformation separate.
purpose: Borrow the useful organizational ideas without making Corpus Pane depend on Spine.

rules.statement: Model bones/anatomy separately from artwork attachments and draw-order slots.
Allow some items or view variants to carry extra controls without forcing every character to use them.
Use host-following relationships for accessories/secondary pieces, but keep them distinct from anatomical joints.
Do not bundle Spine runtime or project assets in Corpus Pane without a separate licensing decision.

implementation.futureWork: Use these separations when designing the poser-stage data model.
